lines.zh: 我每跳一下，黏液拉出一条线。
lines.en: Each hop leaves a line of slime.
The landing sounds wet.

lines.zh: 我贴在雾里，几乎看不清。
lines.en: I cling to the fog, nearly invisible.
I hop toward the warmth.
Legs extend and fold. I spring far.

lines.zh: 黏液让我的脚在石头上打滑。
lines.en: Slime makes my feet slip on the stone.
This ground is cold. I don't like it.
I hop around a crack.

lines.zh: 我的肚子贴着地，一下一下。
lines.en: My belly touches the ground, again and again.
I head where the fog is thicker.
After each hop I pause.
I'm watching whether anything moves.

lines.zh: 我蹲在湿石上，舌头顶着上颚。
lines.en: On the wet stone, my tongue rests against my palate.
Fog flows over me.
There's nothing in this place.
I wait for a footstep.
My hide is wet and slick.
I count the shapes in the fog.
None of them move.
The shape's still. So am I.
I swell my throat slowly.
The road ahead has no visible bottom.
You came out of the fog.
One hop and I'm in front of you.

lines.zh: 你退了，我的鼓膜还在跳。
lines.en: You step back; my tympanum still throbs.
The fog will catch up to you.
I don't need speed. I only need to hop.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your ankles. I see them clearly.
I crouch and gather.
You can tell I'm about to jump.
But you can't dodge.

lines.zh: 我的肚子卡在这条石缝里。
lines.en: My belly is stuck in this stone crack.
I slid off and hit the stone.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的东西，咽回去了。
lines.en: What was in my throat, I swallowed back.
A tear in my hide. Sticky.
I hop back into the fog.
I can still hop with this.
I squat and recover slowly.
You hit me. I didn't stop.
Legs weak. I can't hop high.
Let me try one more hop.
This much, and I can still hop.
I don't eat that.
I sniff. Nothing.
Only what's in the fog is fresh.
You hold it up and stand too close.
I squat and watch you.
Not the thing. You.
Your hand is too far forward.
Just set the thing down.
Then, after setting it down, back away.
Further back. Don't come close.
You hit me and slid off.
I'm too slick to grip.
I hop right over your head.
On landing I hit the wall.
Don't step on me. You'll slip.
We're jammed together. Can't move.
I shift half a foot aside.

lines.zh: 我弹开一步，肚皮还在晃。
lines.en: I bounce back a step, belly still wobbling.
At that, my throat swelled.

lines.zh: 我鼓起喉囊，冲你鼓一声。
lines.en: I puff my throat sac and croak at you.
There's no one else of my kind in the fog.

lines.zh: 我们蹲在一起，也不说话。
lines.en: We squat together and don't speak.
Your hide is drier than mine.

lines.zh: 叫声在水洼上响，等回应。
lines.en: My call rings over the pool, waiting for an answer.
When it's a little warmer.
When the fog lifts, we go.
You hop further than I do.
Then I'll follow you.
Don't hop so fast. Wait for me.
Short legs. I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我用黏糊糊的前爪踩住它。
lines.en: I pin it with a sticky forefoot.
There's fog-water on this.
Too heavy. I couldn't hop.
I don't jump high, but I land true.
It's yours. I won't touch it.
I bite down, and my teeth sink nowhere.

lines.zh: 我把它咽进鼓鼓的肚子。
lines.en: I gulp it into my bulging belly.
Then it won't fall.
If I can't carry it, I leave it.
Rested. Hop on.
Something's moving in the fog.

lines.zh: 我的眼珠先转，身体后转。
lines.en: My eye turns first; my body follows.
My throat swells.
I've judged the hop distance.
One hop reaches it.
I press my chin to the wet mud.
Hind legs loaded. I can leap anytime.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤和石头一个颜色。
lines.en: My skin matches the stone exactly.
Fog this thick helps me.
One hop. Close enough.
Don't hesitate. Leap.
Hold on. Don't let it back away.
It backed off. I close in.
Then I hop again.
I have many more.
It could back away. It doesn't.
Hop after hop, I follow.
I crouch on my hind legs and leap again.
It runs. I speed up.

lines.zh: 雾在它前面，它看不见路。
lines.en: Fog ahead of it. It can't see the way.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探出头，数它的脚。
lines.en: I poke my head from the crack and count its feet.
It turns, and I hop away.
Back and forth and it tires.
My legs still have strength. I'm not tired.
My legs keep their strength.
Listen. It's panting.
Its heartbeat. I hear it.
One more hop.
It's backed to the rock face.
No path that way. Only ash.

lines.zh: 我把身子压进泥里，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I sink into the mud, eyes only.
It's watching me. Hands up.
Hands up is wasted effort.

lines.zh: 我从水洼底下，慢慢浮上来。
lines.en: From beneath the pool, I slowly surface.

lines.zh: 它的影子一近，我就弹起来。
lines.en: The moment its shadow nears, I spring.
Bite. Don't let go.
I leap onto its leg.
My mouth opens wide.
Once I've bitten, I drop my weight.
Not much weight, but I cling.
It shakes its leg. I don't come off.

lines.zh: 我换了个位置，咬得更上面。
lines.en: I shift my grip and bite higher.
This bite goes for the tendon.
It's gone down on one knee.
I let go and hop onto its back.
From behind, it can't reach me.
One more hop and I'm at the neck.
I climb up slowly.

lines.zh: 深渊的蛙，开始乱了步子。
lines.en: The abyssal frog loses its step.
On its leg. Close enough.
Hold it just so.
Don't struggle. My teeth bite harder.
The fog will cover the sound.
It'll be over soon.
I'm very good at this.
Always have been.
I drop out of the fog.
No sound on landing.
This place is so cold — abyssal wind.
I squat and swell my throat.
Nothing is visible around me.
The damper it is, the better I like it.

lines.zh: 没有光的地方，正合我意。
lines.en: A lightless place suits me.

lines.zh: 我从泥里钻出，眼睛先露。
lines.en: I rise from the mud, eyes first.
I hop once that way.
That way. And again.
The fog moves with me.
It always does.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的皮就缩起来。
lines.en: Fire makes my hide shrink.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，翻了个身。
lines.en: I fell from height and turned over.
The water's too deep. I can't hop out.
The blast slammed me into the rock.
Something struck my leg.

lines.zh: 那光一闪，我鼓起的喉咙瘪了。
lines.en: A flash, and my throat went flat.
Too long hungry. I can't hop.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我一跳三尺高。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I jumped three feet straight up.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我落不下去。
lines.en: No ground here. I can't land.
